verdict.rationale: gstack is an AI-agent tooling layer that handles user code and collects usage telemetry, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it commits to keeping user data out of model training. The evidence pack has no training opt-out, no no-training policy, and no data-use commitment. The community note that telemetry can be opted out is an adjacent control, not a documented guarantee against training use, so it earns no credit.
